title: Time Travel?
content: Hi all, First post here. I have visited Mall World on and off for years and resonate with some of your experiences. I have just awoken from a strange dream. In the dream, I was driving solo attempting to get home. However, as soon as I drove across a real-life intersection that was replicated in the dream, I was transported to a mall called "Centrepoint" that was allegedly in a real-life town I know. Problem is, this town is a good fifty minutes away from where I was driving. Once at Centrepoint, my sister was with me. We walked into a known clothing store we have in this world. We spoke with a shop assistant and were looking at a beautiful dress. Here's where it gets weird. I make an off-the-cuff comment about how we must have time travelled here because we live 50 minutes away, and immediately the shop assistant stared at us, and we were "reset", standing at the beginning of Centrepoint and about to start making our way back to this same shop. I remember feeling disoriented. We then walked into the shop, had the same conversation, I mentioned time travel again, and the sequence again restarted. I turned to my sister, once again at the start of Centrepoint, and said that "we are not supposed to know about that." I've read your posts about visiting restricted areas and being corrected by guards of sorts, but I've not seen anything about time travel. Has anyone had a similar experience?
